walrus-docs/contracts/subsidies/sources/subsidies.move
```
1 | // Copyright (c) Mysten Labs, Inc.
2 | // SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
3 | 
4 | /// Module: `subsidies`
5 | ///
6 | /// Module to manage a shared subsidy pool, allowing for discounted
7 | /// storage costs for buyers and contributing to a subsidy for storage nodes.
8 | /// It provides functionality to:
9 | ///  - Add funds to the shared subsidy pool.
10 | ///  - Set subsidy rates for buyers and storage nodes.
11 | ///  - Apply subsidies when reserving storage or extending blob lifetimes.
12 | module subsidies::subsidies;
13 | 
14 | use sui::{balance::{Self, Balance}, coin::Coin};
15 | use wal::wal::WAL;
16 | use walrus::{blob::Blob, storage_resource::Storage, system::System};
17 | 
18 | /// Track the current version of the module
19 | const VERSION: u64 = 2;
20 | 
21 | /// Subsidy rate is in basis points (1/100 of a percent).
22 | const MAX_SUBSIDY_RATE: u16 = 10_000; // 100%
23 | 
24 | // === Errors ===
25 | /// The provided subsidy rate is invalid.
26 | const EInvalidSubsidyRate: u64 = 0;
27 | /// The admin cap is not authorized for the `Subsidies` object.
28 | const EUnauthorizedAdminCap: u64 = 1;
29 | /// The package version is not compatible with the `Subsidies` object.
30 | const EWrongVersion: u64 = 2;
31 | 
32 | // === Structs ===
33 | 
34 | /// Capability to perform admin operations, tied to a specific Subsidies object.
35 | ///
36 | /// Only the holder of this capability can modify subsidy rates
37 | public struct AdminCap has key, store {
38 |     id: UID,
39 |     subsidies_id: ID,
40 | }
41 | 
42 | /// Subsidy rates are expressed in basis points (1/100 of a percent).
43 | /// A subsidy rate of 100 basis points means a 1% subsidy.
44 | /// The maximum subsidy rate is 10,000 basis points (100%).
45 | public struct Subsidies has key, store {
46 |     id: UID,
47 |     /// The subsidy rate applied to the buyer at the moment of storage purchase
48 |     /// in basis points.
49 |     buyer_subsidy_rate: u16,
50 |     /// The subsidy rate applied to the storage node when buying storage in basis
51 |     /// points.
52 |     system_subsidy_rate: u16,
53 |     /// The balance of funds available in the subsidy pool.
54 |     subsidy_pool: Balance<WAL>,
55 |     /// Package ID of the subsidies contract.
56 |     package_id: ID,
57 |     /// The version of the subsidies contract.
58 |     version: u64,
59 | }
60 | 
61 | /// Creates a new `Subsidies` object and an `AdminCap`.
62 | public fun new(package_id: ID, ctx: &mut TxContext): AdminCap {
63 |     let subsidies = Subsidies {
64 |         id: object::new(ctx),
65 |         buyer_subsidy_rate: 0,
66 |         system_subsidy_rate: 0,
67 |         package_id,
68 |         subsidy_pool: balance::zero(),
69 |         version: VERSION,
70 |     };
71 |     let admin_cap = AdminCap { id: object::new(ctx), subsidies_id: object::id(&subsidies) };
72 |     transfer::share_object(subsidies);
73 |     admin_cap
74 | }
75 | 
76 | /// Creates a new `Subsidies` object with initial rates and funds and an `AdminCap`.
77 | public fun new_with_initial_rates_and_funds(
78 |     package_id: ID,
79 |     initial_buyer_subsidy_rate: u16,
80 |     initial_system_subsidy_rate: u16,
81 |     initial_funds: Coin<WAL>,
82 |     ctx: &mut TxContext,
83 | ): AdminCap {
84 |     assert!(initial_buyer_subsidy_rate <= MAX_SUBSIDY_RATE, EInvalidSubsidyRate);
85 |     assert!(initial_system_subsidy_rate <= MAX_SUBSIDY_RATE, EInvalidSubsidyRate);
86 |     let subsidies = Subsidies {
87 |         id: object::new(ctx),
88 |         buyer_subsidy_rate: initial_buyer_subsidy_rate,
89 |         system_subsidy_rate: initial_system_subsidy_rate,
90 |         subsidy_pool: initial_funds.into_balance(),
91 |         package_id,
92 |         version: VERSION,
93 |     };
94 |     let admin_cap = AdminCap { id: object::new(ctx), subsidies_id: object::id(&subsidies) };
95 |     transfer::share_object(subsidies);
96 |     admin_cap
97 | }
98 | 
99 | /// Add additional funds to the subsidy pool.
100 | ///
101 | /// These funds will be used to provide discounts for buyers
102 | /// and rewards to storage nodes.
103 | public fun add_funds(self: &mut Subsidies, funds: Coin<WAL>) {
104 |     self.subsidy_pool.join(funds.into_balance());
105 | }
106 | 
107 | /// Check if the admin cap is valid for this subsidies object.
108 | ///
109 | /// Aborts if the cap does not match.
110 | fun check_admin(self: &Subsidies, admin_cap: &AdminCap) {
111 |     assert!(object::id(self) == admin_cap.subsidies_id, EUnauthorizedAdminCap);
112 | }
113 | 
114 | fun check_version_upgrade(self: &Subsidies) {
115 |     assert!(self.version < VERSION, EWrongVersion);
116 | }
117 | 
118 | /// Set the subsidy rate for buyers, in basis points.
119 | ///
120 | /// Aborts if new_rate is greater than the max value.
121 | public fun set_buyer_subsidy_rate(self: &mut Subsidies, cap: &AdminCap, new_rate: u16) {
122 |     check_admin(self, cap);
123 |     assert!(new_rate <= MAX_SUBSIDY_RATE, EInvalidSubsidyRate);
124 |     self.buyer_subsidy_rate = new_rate;
125 | }
126 | 
127 | /// Set the subsidy rate for storage nodes, in basis points.
128 | ///
129 | /// Aborts if new_rate is greater than the max value.
130 | public fun set_system_subsidy_rate(self: &mut Subsidies, cap: &AdminCap, new_rate: u16) {
131 |     check_admin(self, cap);
132 |     assert!(new_rate <= MAX_SUBSIDY_RATE, EInvalidSubsidyRate);
133 |     self.system_subsidy_rate = new_rate;
134 | }
135 | 
136 | /// Applies subsidies and sends rewards to the system.
137 | ///
138 | /// This will deduct funds from the subsidy pool,
139 | /// and send the storage node subsidy to the system.
140 | fun apply_subsidies(
141 |     self: &mut Subsidies,
142 |     cost: u64,
143 |     epochs_ahead: u32,
144 |     payment: &mut Coin<WAL>,
145 |     system: &mut System,
146 |     ctx: &mut TxContext,
147 | ) {
148 |     // Return early if the subsidy pool is empty.
149 |     if (self.subsidy_pool.value() == 0) {
150 |         return
151 |     };
152 | 
153 |     let buyer_subsidy = cost * (self.buyer_subsidy_rate as u64) / (MAX_SUBSIDY_RATE as u64);
154 |     let system_subsidy = cost * (self.system_subsidy_rate as u64) / (MAX_SUBSIDY_RATE as u64);
155 |     let total_subsidy = buyer_subsidy + system_subsidy;
156 | 
157 |     // Apply subsidy up to the available amount in the pool.
158 |     let (buyer_subsidy, system_subsidy) = if (self.subsidy_pool.value() >= total_subsidy) {
159 |         (buyer_subsidy, system_subsidy)
160 |     } else {
161 |         // If we don't have enough in the pool to pay the full subsidies,
162 |         // split the remainder proportionally between the buyer and system subsidies.
163 |         let pool_value = self.subsidy_pool.value();
164 |         let total_subsidy_rate = self.buyer_subsidy_rate + self.system_subsidy_rate;
165 |         let buyer_subsidy =
166 |             pool_value * (self.buyer_subsidy_rate as u64) / (total_subsidy_rate as u64);
167 |         let system_subsidy =
168 |             pool_value * (self.system_subsidy_rate as u64) / (total_subsidy_rate as u64);
169 |         (buyer_subsidy, system_subsidy)
170 |     };
171 |     let buyer_subsidy_coin = self.subsidy_pool.split(buyer_subsidy).into_coin(ctx);
172 |     payment.join(buyer_subsidy_coin);
173 | 
174 |     let system_subsidy_coin = self.subsidy_pool.split(system_subsidy).into_coin(ctx);
175 |     system.add_subsidy(system_subsidy_coin, epochs_ahead)
176 | }
177 | 
178 | /// Extends a blob's lifetime and applies the buyer and storage node subsidies.
179 | ///
180 | /// It first extends the blob lifetime using system `extend_blob` method.
181 | /// Then it applies the subsidies and deducts the funds from the subsidy pool.
182 | public fun extend_blob(
183 |     self: &mut Subsidies,
184 |     system: &mut System,
185 |     blob: &mut Blob,
186 |     epochs_ahead: u32,
187 |     payment: &mut Coin<WAL>,
188 |     ctx: &mut TxContext,
189 | ) {
190 |     assert!(self.version == VERSION, EWrongVersion);
191 |     let initial_payment_value = payment.value();
192 |     system.extend_blob(blob, epochs_ahead, payment);
193 |     self.apply_subsidies(
194 |         initial_payment_value - payment.value(),
195 |         epochs_ahead,
196 |         payment,
197 |         system,
198 |         ctx,
199 |     );
200 | }
201 | 
202 | /// Reserves storage space and applies the buyer and storage node subsidies.
203 | ///
204 | /// It first reserves the space using system `reserve_space` method.
205 | /// Then it applies the subsidies and deducts the funds from the subsidy pool.
206 | public fun reserve_space(
207 |     self: &mut Subsidies,
208 |     system: &mut System,
209 |     storage_amount: u64,
210 |     epochs_ahead: u32,
211 |     payment: &mut Coin<WAL>,
212 |     ctx: &mut TxContext,
213 | ): Storage {
214 |     assert!(self.version == VERSION, EWrongVersion);
215 |     let initial_payment_value = payment.value();
216 |     let storage = system.reserve_space(storage_amount, epochs_ahead, payment, ctx);
217 |     self.apply_subsidies(
218 |         initial_payment_value - payment.value(),
219 |         epochs_ahead,
220 |         payment,
221 |         system,
222 |         ctx,
223 |     );
224 |     storage
225 | }
226 | 
227 | entry fun migrate(subsidies: &mut Subsidies, admin_cap: &AdminCap, package_id: ID) {
228 |     check_admin(subsidies, admin_cap);
229 |     check_version_upgrade(subsidies);

1 | // Copyright (c) Mysten Labs, Inc.
2 | // SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
3 | 
4 | /// Module: wal_exchange
5 | module wal_exchange::wal_exchange;
6 | 
7 | use sui::{balance::{Self, Balance}, coin::Coin, sui::SUI};
8 | use wal::wal::WAL;
9 | 
10 | // Keep errors in `walrus-sui/types/move_errors.rs` up to date with changes here.
11 | const EInsufficientFundsInExchange: u64 = 0;
12 | const EInsufficientInputBalance: u64 = 1;
13 | const EUnauthorizedAdminCap: u64 = 2;
14 | const EInvalidExchangeRate: u64 = 3;
15 | 
16 | /// A public exchange that allows exchanging SUI for WAL at a fixed exchange rate.
17 | public struct Exchange has key, store {
18 |     id: UID,
19 |     wal: Balance<WAL>,
20 |     sui: Balance<SUI>,
21 |     rate: ExchangeRate,
22 |     admin: ID,
23 | }
24 | 
25 | /// Capability that allows the holder to modify an `Exchange`'s exchange rate and withdraw funds.
26 | public struct AdminCap has key, store {
27 |     id: UID,
28 | }
29 | 
30 | /// Represents an exchange rate: `wal` WAL = `sui` SUI.
31 | public struct ExchangeRate has copy, drop, store {
32 |     wal: u64,
33 |     sui: u64,
34 | }
35 | 
36 | // === Functions for `ExchangeRate` ===
37 | 
38 | /// Creates a new exchange rate, making sure it is valid.
39 | public fun new_exchange_rate(wal: u64, sui: u64): ExchangeRate {
40 |     assert!(wal != 0 && sui != 0, EInvalidExchangeRate);
41 |     ExchangeRate { wal, sui }
42 | }
43 | 
44 | fun wal_to_sui(self: &ExchangeRate, amount: u64): u64 {
45 |     amount * self.sui / self.wal
46 | }
47 | 
48 | fun sui_to_wal(self: &ExchangeRate, amount: u64): u64 {
49 |     amount * self.wal / self.sui
50 | }
51 | 
52 | // === Functions for `Exchange` ===
53 | 
54 | // Creation functions
55 | 
56 | /// Creates a new shared exchange with a 1:1 exchange rate and returns the associated `AdminCap`.
57 | public fun new(ctx: &mut TxContext): AdminCap {
58 |     let admin_cap = AdminCap {
59 |         id: object::new(ctx),
60 |     };
61 |     transfer::share_object(Exchange {
62 |         id: object::new(ctx),
63 |         wal: balance::zero(),
64 |         sui: balance::zero(),
65 |         rate: ExchangeRate { wal: 1, sui: 1 },
66 |         admin: object::id(&admin_cap),
67 |     });
68 |     admin_cap
69 | }
70 | 
71 | /// Creates a new shared exchange with a 1:1 exchange rate, funds it with WAL, and returns the
72 | /// associated `AdminCap`.
73 | public fun new_funded(wal: &mut Coin<WAL>, amount: u64, ctx: &mut TxContext): AdminCap {
74 |     let admin_cap = AdminCap {
75 |         id: object::new(ctx),
76 |     };
77 |     let mut exchange = Exchange {
78 |         id: object::new(ctx),
79 |         wal: balance::zero(),
80 |         sui: balance::zero(),
81 |         rate: ExchangeRate { wal: 1, sui: 1 },
82 |         admin: object::id(&admin_cap),
83 |     };
84 |     exchange.add_wal(wal, amount);
85 | 
86 |     transfer::share_object(exchange);
87 |     admin_cap
88 | }
89 | 
90 | /// Adds WAL to the balance stored in the exchange.
91 | public fun add_wal(self: &mut Exchange, wal: &mut Coin<WAL>, amount: u64) {
92 |     self.wal.join(wal.balance_mut().split(amount));
93 | }
94 | 
95 | /// Adds SUI to the balance stored in the exchange.
96 | public fun add_sui(self: &mut Exchange, sui: &mut Coin<SUI>, amount: u64) {
97 |     self.sui.join(sui.balance_mut().split(amount));
98 | }
99 | 
100 | /// Adds WAL to the balance stored in the exchange.
101 | public fun add_all_wal(self: &mut Exchange, wal: Coin<WAL>) {
102 |     self.wal.join(wal.into_balance());
103 | }
104 | 
105 | /// Adds SUI to the balance stored in the exchange.
106 | public fun add_all_sui(self: &mut Exchange, sui: Coin<SUI>) {
107 |     self.sui.join(sui.into_balance());
108 | }
109 | 
110 | // Admin functions
111 | 
112 | fun check_admin(self: &Exchange, admin_cap: &AdminCap) {
113 |     assert!(self.admin == object::id(admin_cap), EUnauthorizedAdminCap);
114 | }
115 | 
116 | /// Withdraws WAL from the balance stored in the exchange.
117 | public fun withdraw_wal(
118 |     self: &mut Exchange,
119 |     amount: u64,
120 |     admin_cap: &AdminCap,
121 |     ctx: &mut TxContext,
122 | ): Coin<WAL> {
123 |     self.check_admin(admin_cap);
124 |     assert!(self.wal.value() >= amount, EInsufficientFundsInExchange);
125 |     self.wal.split(amount).into_coin(ctx)
126 | }
127 | 
128 | /// Withdraws SUI from the balance stored in the exchange.
129 | public fun withdraw_sui(
130 |     self: &mut Exchange,
131 |     amount: u64,
132 |     admin_cap: &AdminCap,
133 |     ctx: &mut TxContext,
134 | ): Coin<SUI> {
135 |     self.check_admin(admin_cap);
136 |     assert!(self.sui.value() >= amount, EInsufficientFundsInExchange);
137 |     self.sui.split(amount).into_coin(ctx)
138 | }
139 | 
140 | /// Sets the exchange rate of the exchange to `wal` WAL = `sui` SUI.
141 | public fun set_exchange_rate(self: &mut Exchange, wal: u64, sui: u64, admin_cap: &AdminCap) {
142 |     self.check_admin(admin_cap);
143 |     self.rate = new_exchange_rate(wal, sui);
144 | }
145 | 
146 | // User functions
147 | 
148 | /// Exchanges the provided SUI coin for WAL at the exchange's rate.
149 | public fun exchange_all_for_wal(
150 |     self: &mut Exchange,
151 |     sui: Coin<SUI>,
152 |     ctx: &mut TxContext,
153 | ): Coin<WAL> {
154 |     let value_wal = self.rate.sui_to_wal(sui.value());
155 |     assert!(self.wal.value() >= value_wal, EInsufficientFundsInExchange);
156 |     self.sui.join(sui.into_balance());
157 |     self.wal.split(value_wal).into_coin(ctx)
158 | }
159 | 
160 | /// Exchanges `amount_sui` out of the provided SUI coin for WAL at the exchange's rate.
161 | public fun exchange_for_wal(
162 |     self: &mut Exchange,
163 |     sui: &mut Coin<SUI>,
164 |     amount_sui: u64,
165 |     ctx: &mut TxContext,
166 | ): Coin<WAL> {
167 |     assert!(sui.value() >= amount_sui, EInsufficientInputBalance);
168 |     self.exchange_all_for_wal(sui.split(amount_sui, ctx), ctx)
169 | }
170 | 
171 | /// Exchanges the provided WAL coin for SUI at the exchange's rate.
172 | public fun exchange_all_for_sui(
173 |     self: &mut Exchange,
174 |     wal: Coin<WAL>,
175 |     ctx: &mut TxContext,
176 | ): Coin<SUI> {
177 |     let value_sui = self.rate.wal_to_sui(wal.value());
178 |     assert!(self.sui.value() >= value_sui, EInsufficientFundsInExchange);
179 |     self.wal.join(wal.into_balance());
180 |     self.sui.split(value_sui).into_coin(ctx)
181 | }
182 | 
183 | /// Exchanges `amount_wal` out of the provided WAL coin for SUI at the exchange's rate.
184 | public fun exchange_for_sui(
185 |     self: &mut Exchange,
186 |     wal: &mut Coin<WAL>,
187 |     amount_wal: u64,
188 |     ctx: &mut TxContext,
189 | ): Coin<SUI> {
190 |     assert!(wal.value() >= amount_wal, EInsufficientInputBalance);
191 |     self.exchange_all_for_sui(wal.split(amount_wal, ctx), ctx)
192 | }
193 |

walrus-docs/contracts/walrus/docs/msg_formats.txt
```
1 | // Copyright (c) Mysten Labs, Inc.
2 | // SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
3 | 
4 | 
5 | We document here off-chain message formats.
6 | 
7 | Signatures
8 | ----------
9 | 
10 | All certified or signed messages SHOULD be signed with the scheme:
11 | BLS_SIG_BLS12381G2_XMD:SHA-256_SSWU_RO_NUL_
12 | 
13 | Public keys are 48 byte vector<u8>.
14 | Signatures are 96 byte vector<u8>.
15 | 
16 | Signed Message Header
17 | ---------------------
18 | 
19 | All messages MUST start with a header of 3 + 4 bytes:
20 | - (Intent_type, Intent_version, Intent_app_id) : (u8, u8, u8)
21 | - epoch: u32
22 | - body: remaining vec<u8>, no length prefix
23 | 
24 | The intent types are enumerated below, the version is as of now 0,
25 | and the app id for storage is 3. Th epoch is the storage epoch the
26 | signing storage node is in when signing the message.
27 | 
28 | Intent types (add here):
29 | 
30 | const PROOF_OF_POSSESSION_MSG_TYPE: u8 = 0;
31 | const BLOB_CERT_MSG_TYPE: u8 = 1;
32 | const INVALID_BLOB_ID_MSG_TYPE: u8 = 2;
33 | const DENY_LIST_UPDATE_MSG_TYPE: u8 = 3;
34 | const DENY_LIST_BLOB_DELETED_MSG_TYPE: u8 = 4;
35 | 
36 | PROOF_OF_POSSESSION message
37 | -----------------
38 | 
39 | The body contains the sui address followed by the bls public key (encoded as 48 byte fixed
40 | size array) of the signer.
41 | 
42 | BLOB_CERT message
43 | -----------------
44 | 
45 | The body is the blob_id : u256 (32 bytes) of a blob followed by the bcs encoding of the blob
46 | persistence type defined below, i.e. 1 byte that is 0 for permanent blobs and 1 for deletable
47 | blobs, followed by the object id of the deletable blob if it is a deletable blob.
48 | 
49 | ```
50 | enum BlobPersistenceType {
51 |     Permanent,
52 |     Deletable { object_id: [u8; 32] },
53 | }
54 | ```
55 | 
56 | The storage node certified that all shards that were assigned to it for the message epoch have
57 | been received, checked and persisted to store.
58 | 
59 | INVALID_BLOB_ID
60 | ---------------
61 | 
62 | The body is the blob_id : u256 (32 bytes) of a blob. The storage node certified that
63 | it has verified an inconsistency proof and the blob id is invalid.
64 | 
65 | DENY_LIST_UPDATE_MSG_TYPE
66 | ---------------
67 | 
68 | The body is the node_id : address (32 bytes) of the storage node,
69 | deny_list_sequence_number : u64 (8 bytes) sequence number, deny_list_size : u64 (8 bytes)
70 | the size of the deny list of the node, deny_list_root : u256 (32 bytes) the root hash of
71 | the deny list.
72 | 
73 | DENY_LIST_BLOB_DELETED_MSG_TYPE
74 | ---------------
75 | 
76 | The body is the blob_id : u256 (32 bytes) of a blob. f+1 nodes have added the blob id to
77 | their deny lists, and the blob should be deleted.
```

walrus-docs/contracts/walrus/sources/init.move
```
1 | // Copyright (c) Mysten Labs, Inc.
2 | // SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
3 | 
4 | module walrus::init;
5 | 
6 | use std::type_name;
7 | use sui::{clock::Clock, package::UpgradeCap};
8 | use walrus::{events, staking::{Self, Staking}, system::{Self, System}, upgrade};
9 | 
10 | // Error codes
11 | // Error types in `walrus-sui/types/move_errors.rs` are auto-generated from the Move error codes.
12 | /// Error during the migration to the new system/staking object versions.
13 | const EInvalidMigration: u64 = 0;
14 | /// The provided upgrade cap does not belong to this package.
15 | const EInvalidUpgradeCap: u64 = 1;
16 | 
17 | /// Must only be created by `init`.
18 | public struct InitCap has key, store {
19 |     id: UID,
20 | }
21 | 
22 | /// Init function, creates an init cap and transfers it to the sender.
23 | /// This allows the sender to call the function to actually initialize the system
24 | /// with the corresponding parameters. Once that function is called, the cap is destroyed.
25 | fun init(ctx: &mut TxContext) {
26 |     let id = object::new(ctx);
27 |     let init_cap = InitCap { id };
28 |     transfer::transfer(init_cap, ctx.sender());
29 | }
30 | 
31 | /// Function to initialize walrus and share the system and staking objects.
32 | /// This can only be called once, after which the `InitCap` is destroyed.
33 | /// TODO: decide what to add as system parameters instead of constants.
34 | public fun initialize_walrus(
35 |     init_cap: InitCap,
36 |     upgrade_cap: UpgradeCap,
37 |     epoch_zero_duration: u64,
38 |     epoch_duration: u64,
39 |     n_shards: u16,
40 |     max_epochs_ahead: u32,
41 |     clock: &Clock,
42 |     ctx: &mut TxContext,
43 | ): upgrade::EmergencyUpgradeCap {
44 |     let package_id = upgrade_cap.package();
45 |     assert!(
46 |         type_name::get<InitCap>().get_address() == package_id.to_address().to_ascii_string(),
47 |         EInvalidUpgradeCap,
48 |     );
49 |     system::create_empty(max_epochs_ahead, package_id, ctx);
50 |     staking::create(epoch_zero_duration, epoch_duration, n_shards, package_id, clock, ctx);
51 |     let emergency_upgrade_cap = upgrade::new(upgrade_cap, ctx);
52 |     init_cap.destroy();
53 |     emergency_upgrade_cap
54 | }
55 | 
56 | /// Migrate the staking and system objects to the new package id.
57 | ///
58 | /// This must be called in the new package after an upgrade is committed
59 | /// to emit an event that informs all storage nodes and prevent previous package
60 | /// versions from being used.
61 | public fun migrate(staking: &mut Staking, system: &mut System) {
62 |     staking.migrate();
63 |     system.migrate();
64 |     // Check that the package id and version are the same.
65 |     assert!(staking.package_id() == system.package_id(), EInvalidMigration);
66 |     assert!(staking.version() == system.version(), EInvalidMigration);
67 |     // Emit an event to inform storage nodes of the upgrade.
68 |     events::emit_contract_upgraded(
69 |         staking.epoch(),
70 |         staking.package_id(),
71 |         staking.version(),
72 |     );
73 | }
74 | 
75 | fun destroy(cap: InitCap) {
76 |     let InitCap { id } = cap;
77 |     id.delete();
78 | }
79 | 
80 | // === Test only ===
81 | 
82 | #[test_only]
83 | public fun init_for_testing(ctx: &mut TxContext) {
84 |     init(ctx);
85 | }
86 | 
87 | #[test_only]
88 | /// Does the same as `initialize_walrus` but does not check the package id of the upgrade cap.
89 | ///
90 | /// This is needed for testing, since the package ID of all types will be zero, which cannot be used
91 | /// as the package ID for an upgrade cap.
92 | public fun initialize_for_testing(
93 |     init_cap: InitCap,
94 |     upgrade_cap: UpgradeCap,
95 |     epoch_zero_duration: u64,
96 |     epoch_duration: u64,
97 |     n_shards: u16,
98 |     max_epochs_ahead: u32,
99 |     clock: &Clock,
100 |     ctx: &mut TxContext,
101 | ): upgrade::EmergencyUpgradeCap {
102 |     let package_id = upgrade_cap.package();
103 |     system::create_empty(max_epochs_ahead, package_id, ctx);
104 |     staking::create(epoch_zero_duration, epoch_duration, n_shards, package_id, clock, ctx);
105 |     let emergency_upgrade_cap = upgrade::new(upgrade_cap, ctx);
106 |     init_cap.destroy();
107 |     emergency_upgrade_cap
108 | }
```

```
1 | // Copyright (c) Mysten Labs, Inc.
2 | // SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
3 | 
4 | #[allow(unused_variable, unused_function, unused_field, unused_mut_parameter)]
5 | /// Module: staking
6 | module walrus::staking;
7 | 
8 | use std::string::String;
9 | use sui::{clock::Clock, coin::Coin, dynamic_field as df};
10 | use wal::wal::WAL;
11 | use walrus::{
12 |     auth::{Self, Authenticated, Authorized},
13 |     committee::Committee,
14 |     node_metadata::NodeMetadata,
15 |     staked_wal::StakedWal,
16 |     staking_inner::{Self, StakingInnerV1},
17 |     storage_node::{Self, StorageNodeCap},
18 |     system::System
19 | };
20 | 
21 | // Error codes
22 | // Error types in `walrus-sui/types/move_errors.rs` are auto-generated from the Move error codes.
23 | /// Error during the migration of the staking object to the new package version.
24 | const EInvalidMigration: u64 = 0;
25 | /// The package version is not compatible with the staking object.
26 | const EWrongVersion: u64 = 1;
27 | 
28 | /// Flag to indicate the version of the Walrus system.
29 | const VERSION: u64 = 2;
30 | 
31 | /// The one and only staking object.
32 | public struct Staking has key {
33 |     id: UID,
34 |     version: u64,
35 |     package_id: ID,
36 |     new_package_id: Option<ID>,
37 | }
38 | 
39 | /// Creates and shares a new staking object.
40 | /// Must only be called by the initialization function.
41 | public(package) fun create(
42 |     epoch_zero_duration: u64,
43 |     epoch_duration: u64,
44 |     n_shards: u16,
45 |     package_id: ID,
46 |     clock: &Clock,
47 |     ctx: &mut TxContext,
48 | ) {
49 |     let mut staking = Staking {
50 |         id: object::new(ctx),
51 |         version: VERSION,
52 |         package_id,
53 |         new_package_id: option::none(),
54 |     };
55 |     df::add(
56 |         &mut staking.id,
57 |         VERSION,
58 |         staking_inner::new(
59 |             epoch_zero_duration,
60 |             epoch_duration,
61 |             n_shards,
62 |             clock,
63 |             ctx,
64 |         ),
65 |     );
66 |     transfer::share_object(staking)
67 | }
68 | 
69 | // === Public API: Storage Node ===
70 | 
71 | /// Creates a staking pool for the candidate, registers the candidate as a storage node.
72 | public fun register_candidate(
73 |     staking: &mut Staking,
74 |     // node info
75 |     name: String,
76 |     network_address: String,
77 |     metadata: NodeMetadata,
78 |     public_key: vector<u8>,
79 |     network_public_key: vector<u8>,
80 |     proof_of_possession: vector<u8>,
81 |     // voting parameters
82 |     commission_rate: u16,
83 |     storage_price: u64,
84 |     write_price: u64,
85 |     node_capacity: u64,
86 |     ctx: &mut TxContext,
87 | ): StorageNodeCap {
88 |     // use the Pool Object ID as the identifier of the storage node
89 |     let staking_mut = staking.inner_mut();
90 |     let node_id = staking_mut.create_pool(
91 |         name,
92 |         network_address,
93 |         metadata,
94 |         public_key,
95 |         network_public_key,
96 |         proof_of_possession,
97 |         commission_rate,
98 |         storage_price,
99 |         write_price,
100 |         node_capacity,
101 |         ctx,
102 |     );
103 | 
104 |     // Switch the commission receiver from the sender (default) to the cap.
105 |     let cap = storage_node::new_cap(node_id, ctx);
106 |     let receiver = auth::authorized_object(object::id(&cap));
107 |     staking_mut.set_commission_receiver(node_id, auth::authenticate_sender(ctx), receiver);
108 |     cap
109 | }
110 | 
111 | // === Commission ===
112 |

235 | // === Accessors ===

239 | }

249 | }

251 | /// Migrate the system object to the new package id.
252 | ///
253 | /// This function sets the new package id and version and can be modified in future versions
254 | /// to migrate changes in the `system_state_inner` object if needed.
255 | public(package) fun migrate(system: &mut System) {
256 |     assert!(system.version < VERSION, EInvalidMigration);
257 | 
258 |     // Move the old system state inner to the new version.
259 |     let system_state_inner: SystemStateInnerV1 = dynamic_field::remove(
260 |         &mut system.id,
261 |         system.version,
262 |     );
263 |     dynamic_field::add(&mut system.id, VERSION, system_state_inner);
264 |     system.version = VERSION;
265 | 
266 |     // Set the new package id.
267 |     assert!(system.new_package_id.is_some(), EInvalidMigration);
268 |     system.package_id = system.new_package_id.extract();
269 | }

274 | fun inner_mut(system: &mut System): &mut SystemStateInnerV1 {
275 |     assert!(system.version == VERSION, EWrongVersion);
276 |     dynamic_field::borrow_mut(&mut system.id, VERSION)
277 | }
278 | 
279 | /// Get an immutable reference to `SystemStateInner` from the `System`.
280 | public(package) fun inner(system: &System): &SystemStateInnerV1 {
281 |     assert!(system.version == VERSION, EWrongVersion);
282 |     dynamic_field::borrow(&system.id, VERSION)
283 | }

1 | // Copyright (c) Mysten Labs, Inc.
2 | // SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
3 | 
4 | /// Module to manage Walrus contract upgrades.
5 | ///
6 | /// This allows upgrading the contract with a quorum of storage nodes or using an emergency upgrade
7 | /// capability.
8 | ///
9 | /// Requiring a quorum instead of a simple majority guarantees that (i) a majority of honest nodes
10 | /// (by weight) have voted for the upgrade, and (ii) that an upgrade cannot be blocked solely by
11 | /// byzantine nodes.
12 | module walrus::upgrade;
13 | 
14 | use sui::{
15 |     package::{UpgradeCap, UpgradeTicket, UpgradeReceipt},
16 |     table::{Self, Table},
17 |     vec_set::{Self, VecSet}
18 | };
19 | use walrus::{auth::Authenticated, events, staking::Staking, system::System};
20 | 
21 | // Error codes
22 | // Error types in `walrus-sui/types/move_errors.rs` are auto-generated from the Move error codes.
23 | /// The upgrade manager ID in the emergency upgrade cap is incorrect.
24 | const EInvalidUpgradeManager: u64 = 0;
25 | /// Caller is not authorized to vote for upgrades for the specified node.
26 | const ENotAuthorized: u64 = 1;
27 | /// The node already voted for the proposal.
28 | const EDuplicateVote: u64 = 2;
29 | /// The length of the package digest is incorrect.
30 | const EInvalidPackageDigest: u64 = 3;
31 | /// No upgrade proposal exists for the specified digest.
32 | const ENoProposalForDigest: u64 = 4;
33 | /// The upgrade proposal was not authorized in the current epoch.
34 | const EWrongEpoch: u64 = 5;
35 | /// The upgrade proposal has not received enough votes yet.
36 | const ENotEnoughVotes: u64 = 6;
37 | /// The upgrade proposal is not for the correct package version.
38 | const EWrongVersion: u64 = 7;
39 | 
40 | /// Newtype for package digests, ensures that the digest is always 32 bytes long.
41 | public struct PackageDigest(vector<u8>) has copy, drop, store;
42 | 
43 | /// An upgrade proposal containing the digest of the package to upgrade to and the votes on the
44 | /// proposal.
45 | public struct UpgradeProposal has drop, store {
46 |     /// The epoch in which the proposal was created.
47 |     /// The upgrade must be performed in the same epoch.
48 |     epoch: u32,
49 |     /// The digest of the package to upgrade to.
50 |     digest: PackageDigest,
51 |     /// The version of the package to upgrade to.
52 |     /// This allows to easily clean up old proposals.
53 |     version: u64,
54 |     /// The voting weight of the proposal.
55 |     voting_weight: u16,
56 |     /// The node IDs that have voted for this proposal.
57 |     /// Note: the number of nodes in the committee is capped, so we can use a VecSet.
58 |     voters: VecSet<ID>,
59 | }
60 | 
61 | /// The upgrade manager object.
62 | ///
63 | /// This object contains the upgrade cap for the package and is used to authorize upgrades.
64 | public struct UpgradeManager has key {
65 |     id: UID,
66 |     cap: UpgradeCap,
67 |     upgrade_proposals: Table<PackageDigest, UpgradeProposal>,
68 | }
69 | 
70 | /// A capability that allows upgrades to be performed without quorum.
71 | ///
72 | /// This is intended for emergency use and should be burned once the community has matured.
73 | public struct EmergencyUpgradeCap has key, store {
74 |     id: UID,
75 |     upgrade_manager_id: ID,
76 | }
77 | 
78 | /// Create a new upgrade manager.
79 | ///
80 | /// This is called from the `init::initialize_walrus` function and will
81 | /// create a unique `UpgradeManager` and `EmergencyUpgradeCap` object.
82 | public(package) fun new(cap: UpgradeCap, ctx: &mut TxContext): EmergencyUpgradeCap {
83 |     let upgrade_manager = UpgradeManager {
84 |         id: object::new(ctx),
85 |         cap,
86 |         upgrade_proposals: table::new(ctx),
87 |     };
88 |     let emergency_upgrade_cap = EmergencyUpgradeCap {
89 |         id: object::new(ctx),
90 |         upgrade_manager_id: object::id(&upgrade_manager),
91 |     };
92 |     transfer::share_object(upgrade_manager);
93 |     emergency_upgrade_cap
94 | }
95 | 
96 | // === Upgrade Manager Public API ===
97 | 
98 | /// Vote for an upgrade given the digest of the package to upgrade to.
99 | ///
100 | /// This will create a new upgrade proposal if none exists for the given digest.
101 | public fun vote_for_upgrade(
102 |     self: &mut UpgradeManager,
103 |     staking: &Staking,
104 |     auth: Authenticated,
105 |     node_id: ID,
106 |     digest: vector<u8>,
107 | ) {
108 |     assert!(staking.check_governance_authorization(node_id, auth), ENotAuthorized);
109 |     let weight = staking.get_current_node_weight(node_id);
110 |     let epoch = staking.epoch();
111 |     let digest = package_digest!(digest);
112 |     // Check if a proposal already exists for the given digest.
113 | 
114 |     let proposal = if (self.upgrade_proposals.contains(digest)) {
115 |         // Check if the proposal is for the current epoch.
116 |         let proposal = self.upgrade_proposals.borrow_mut(digest);
117 |         // check epoch and version and reset if they don't match
118 |         if (proposal.epoch != epoch || proposal.version != self.cap.version() + 1) {
119 |             *proposal = fresh_proposal(epoch, digest, self.cap.version() + 1);
120 |         };
121 |         proposal
122 |     } else {
123 |         let proposal = fresh_proposal(epoch, digest, self.cap.version() + 1);
124 |         self.upgrade_proposals.add(digest, proposal);
125 |         self.upgrade_proposals.borrow_mut(digest)
126 |     };
127 |     proposal.add_vote(node_id, weight);
128 |     // Check if the proposal has reached quorum and emit an event if it has.
129 |     if (staking.is_quorum(proposal.voting_weight)) {
130 |         events::emit_contract_upgrade_quorum_reached(epoch, digest.0);
131 |     }
132 | }
133 | 
134 | /// Authorizes an upgrade that has reached quorum.
135 | public fun authorize_upgrade(
136 |     self: &mut UpgradeManager,
137 |     staking: &Staking,
138 |     digest: vector<u8>,
139 | ): UpgradeTicket {
140 |     let digest = package_digest!(digest);
141 | 
142 |     assert!(self.upgrade_proposals.contains(digest), ENoProposalForDigest);
143 |     let proposal = self.upgrade_proposals.remove(digest);
144 | 
145 |     // Check that the proposal is for the current epoch and that the quorum is reached.
146 |     assert!(proposal.epoch == staking.epoch(), EWrongEpoch);
147 |     assert!(staking.is_quorum(proposal.voting_weight), ENotEnoughVotes);
148 | 
149 |     // Check that the version is correct.
150 |     assert!(self.cap.version() + 1 == proposal.version, EWrongVersion);
151 | 
152 |     let policy = self.cap.policy();
153 |     self.cap.authorize(policy, digest.0)
154 | }
155 | 
156 | /// Authorizes an upgrade using the emergency upgrade cap.
157 | ///
158 | /// This should be used sparingly and once walrus has a healthy community and governance,
159 | /// the EmergencyUpgradeCap should be burned.
160 | public fun authorize_emergency_upgrade(
161 |     upgrade_manager: &mut UpgradeManager,
162 |     emergency_upgrade_cap: &EmergencyUpgradeCap,
163 |     digest: vector<u8>,
164 | ): UpgradeTicket {
165 |     assert!(
166 |         emergency_upgrade_cap.upgrade_manager_id == object::id(upgrade_manager),
167 |         EInvalidUpgradeManager,
168 |     );
169 |     let policy = upgrade_manager.cap.policy();
170 |     upgrade_manager.cap.authorize(policy, digest)
171 | }
172 | 
173 | /// Commits an upgrade and sets the new package id in the staking and system objects.
174 | ///
175 | /// After committing an upgrade, the staking and system objects should be migrated
176 | /// using the [`package::migrate`] function to emit an event that informs all storage nodes
177 | /// and prevent previous package versions from being used.
178 | public fun commit_upgrade(
179 |     upgrade_manager: &mut UpgradeManager,
180 |     staking: &mut Staking,
181 |     system: &mut System,
182 |     receipt: UpgradeReceipt,
183 | ) {
184 |     let new_package_id = receipt.package();
185 |     staking.set_new_package_id(new_package_id);
186 |     system.set_new_package_id(new_package_id);
187 |     upgrade_manager.cap.commit(receipt)
188 | }
189 | 
190 | /// Cleans up the upgrade proposals table.
191 | ///
192 | /// Deletes all proposals from past epochs and versions that are lower than the current version.
193 | public fun cleanup_upgrade_proposals(
194 |     self: &mut UpgradeManager,
195 |     staking: &Staking,
196 |     proposals: vector<vector<u8>>,
197 | ) {
198 |     proposals.do!(|digest| {
199 |         let digest = package_digest!(digest);
200 |         if (self.upgrade_proposals.contains(digest)) {
201 |             let proposal = self.upgrade_proposals.borrow(digest);
202 |             if (proposal.version <= self.cap.version() || proposal.epoch < staking.epoch()) {
203 |                 self.upgrade_proposals.remove(digest);
204 |             }
205 |         }
206 |     });
207 | }
208 | 
209 | // === Emergency Upgrade Cap Public API ===
210 | 
211 | /// Burns the emergency upgrade cap.
212 | ///
213 | /// This will prevent any further upgrades using the `EmergencyUpgradeCap` and will
214 | /// make upgrades fully reliant on quorum-based governance.
215 | public fun burn_emergency_upgrade_cap(emergency_upgrade_cap: EmergencyUpgradeCap) {
216 |     let EmergencyUpgradeCap { id, .. } = emergency_upgrade_cap;
217 |     id.delete();
218 | }
219 | 
220 | // === Upgrade Manager internal functions ===
221 | 
222 | /// Creates a new upgrade proposal.
223 | ///
224 | /// This will emit an event that signals that a new upgrade proposal has been created.
225 | fun fresh_proposal(epoch: u32, digest: PackageDigest, version: u64): UpgradeProposal {
226 |     events::emit_contract_upgrade_proposed(epoch, digest.0);
227 |     UpgradeProposal { epoch, digest, version, voting_weight: 0, voters: vec_set::empty() }
228 | }
229 | 
230 | /// Adds a vote to an upgrade proposal.
231 | fun add_vote(proposal: &mut UpgradeProposal, node_id: ID, weight: u16) {
232 |     assert!(!proposal.voters.contains(&node_id), EDuplicateVote);
233 |     proposal.voters.insert(node_id);
234 |     proposal.voting_weight = proposal.voting_weight + weight;
235 | }
236 | 
237 | // === Package Digest ===
238 | 
239 | /// Creates a new package digest given a byte vector.
240 | ///
241 | /// Aborts if the digest is not 32 bytes long.
242 | macro fun package_digest($digest: vector<u8>): PackageDigest {
243 |     let digest = $digest;
244 |     assert!(digest.length() == 32, EInvalidPackageDigest);
245 |     PackageDigest(digest)
246 | }
247 | 
248 | // === Test only ===
249 | 
250 | #[test_only]
251 | public fun digest_for_testing(ctx: &mut TxContext): vector<u8> {
252 |     ctx.fresh_object_address().to_bytes()
253 | }
```

1 | // Copyright (c) Mysten Labs, Inc.

4 | module walrus::e2e_runner;
5 | 
6 | use sui::{clock::{Self, Clock}, test_scenario::{Self, Scenario}, test_utils};
7 | use walrus::{
8 |     init,
9 |     node_metadata,
10 |     staking::Staking,
11 |     system::System,
12 |     test_node::{Self, TestStorageNode},
13 |     test_utils as walrus_test_utils,
14 |     upgrade::UpgradeManager
15 | };
16 | 
17 | const MAX_EPOCHS_AHEAD: u32 = 104;
18 | const DEFAULT_EPOCH_ZERO_DURATION: u64 = 100000000;
19 | const DEFAULT_EPOCH_DURATION: u64 = 7 * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000 / 2;
20 | const DEFAULT_N_SHARDS: u16 = 100;
21 | 
22 | // === Tests Runner ===
23 | 
24 | /// The test runner for end-to-end tests.
25 | public struct TestRunner {
26 |     scenario: Scenario,
27 |     clock: Clock,
28 |     admin: address,
29 | }
30 | 
31 | /// Add any parameters to the initialization, such as epoch zero duration and number of shards.
32 | /// They will be used by the e2e runner admin during the initialization.
33 | public struct InitBuilder {
34 |     epoch_zero_duration: Option<u64>,
35 |     epoch_duration: Option<u64>,
36 |     n_shards: Option<u16>,
37 |     admin: address,
38 | }
39 | 
40 | /// Prepare the test runner with the given admin address. Returns a builder to
41 | /// set optional parameters: `epoch_zero_duration` and `n_shards`.
42 | ///
43 | /// Example:
44 | /// ```move
45 | /// let admin = 0xA11CE;
46 | /// let mut runner = e2e_runner::prepare(admin)
47 | ///    .epoch_zero_duration(100000000)
48 | ///    .n_shards(100)
49 | ///    .build();
50 | ///
51 | /// runner.tx!(admin, |staking, system, ctx| { /* ... */ });
52 | /// ```
53 | public fun prepare(admin: address): InitBuilder {
54 |     InitBuilder {
55 |         epoch_zero_duration: option::none(),
56 |         epoch_duration: option::none(),
57 |         n_shards: option::none(),
58 |         admin,
59 |     }
60 | }
61 | 
62 | /// Change the epoch zero duration.
63 | public fun epoch_zero_duration(mut self: InitBuilder, duration: u64): InitBuilder {
64 |     self.epoch_zero_duration = option::some(duration);
65 |     self
66 | }
67 | 
68 | /// Change the regular (non-zero) epoch duration.
69 | public fun epoch_duration(mut self: InitBuilder, duration: u64): InitBuilder {
70 |     self.epoch_duration = option::some(duration);
71 |     self
72 | }
73 | 
74 | /// Change the number of shards in the system.
75 | public fun n_shards(mut self: InitBuilder, n: u16): InitBuilder {
76 |     self.n_shards = option::some(n);
77 |     self
78 | }
79 | 
80 | /// Build the test runner with the given parameters.
81 | public fun build(self: InitBuilder): TestRunner {
82 |     let InitBuilder { admin, epoch_duration, epoch_zero_duration, n_shards } = self;
83 |     let epoch_zero_duration = epoch_zero_duration.destroy_or!(DEFAULT_EPOCH_ZERO_DURATION);
84 |     let epoch_duration = epoch_duration.destroy_or!(DEFAULT_EPOCH_DURATION);
85 |     let n_shards = n_shards.destroy_or!(DEFAULT_N_SHARDS);
86 | 
87 |     let mut scenario = test_scenario::begin(admin);
88 |     let clock = clock::create_for_testing(scenario.ctx());
89 |     let ctx = scenario.ctx();
90 | 
91 |     init::init_for_testing(ctx);
92 | 
93 |     // We need an upgrade cap for package with address 0x0
94 |     let upgrade_cap = sui::package::test_publish(ctx.fresh_object_address().to_id(), ctx);
95 | 
96 |     scenario.next_tx(admin);
97 |     let cap = scenario.take_from_sender<init::InitCap>();
98 |     let ctx = scenario.ctx();
99 |     let emergency_upgrade_cap = init::initialize_for_testing(
100 |         cap,
101 |         upgrade_cap,
102 |         epoch_zero_duration,
103 |         epoch_duration,
104 |         n_shards,
105 |         MAX_EPOCHS_AHEAD,
106 |         &clock,
107 |         ctx,
108 |     );
109 | 
110 |     transfer::public_transfer(emergency_upgrade_cap, admin);
111 |     scenario.next_tx(admin);
112 | 
113 |     TestRunner { scenario, clock, admin }
114 | }
115 | 
116 | /// Get the admin address that published Walrus System and Staking.
117 | public fun admin(self: &TestRunner): address { self.admin }
118 | 
119 | /// Access runner's `Scenario`.
120 | public fun scenario(self: &mut TestRunner): &mut Scenario { &mut self.scenario }
121 | 
122 | /// Access runner's `Clock`.
123 | public fun clock(self: &mut TestRunner): &mut Clock { &mut self.clock }
124 | 
125 | /// Access the current epoch of the system.
126 | public fun epoch(self: &mut TestRunner): u32 {
127 |     self.scenario.next_tx(self.admin);
128 |     let system = self.scenario.take_shared<System>();
129 |     let epoch = system.epoch();
130 |     test_scenario::return_shared(system);
131 |     epoch
132 | }
133 | 
134 | /// Returns the default epoch duration.
135 | public fun default_epoch_duration(): u64 { DEFAULT_EPOCH_DURATION }
136 | 
137 | /// Run a transaction as a `sender`, and call the function `f` with the `Staking`,
138 | /// `System`, and `TxContext` as arguments.
139 | public macro fun tx(
140 |     $runner: &mut TestRunner,
141 |     $sender: address,
142 |     $f: |&mut Staking, &mut System, &mut TxContext|,
143 | ) {
144 |     let runner = $runner;
145 |     let scenario = runner.scenario();
146 |     scenario.next_tx($sender);
147 |     let mut staking = scenario.take_shared<Staking>();
148 |     let mut system = scenario.take_shared<System>();
149 |     let ctx = scenario.ctx();
150 | 
151 |     $f(&mut staking, &mut system, ctx);
152 | 
153 |     test_scenario::return_shared(staking);
154 |     test_scenario::return_shared(system);
155 | }
156 | 
157 | /// Returns TransactionEffects of the last transaction.
158 | public fun last_tx_effects(runner: &mut TestRunner): test_scenario::TransactionEffects {
159 |     runner.scenario().next_tx(@1)
160 | }
161 | 
162 | /// Run a transaction as a `sender`, and call the function `f` with the `Staking`,
163 | /// `System`, `UpgradeManager`, and `TxContext` as arguments.
164 | public macro fun tx_with_upgrade_manager(
165 |     $runner: &mut TestRunner,
166 |     $sender: address,
167 |     $f: |&mut Staking, &mut System, &mut UpgradeManager, &mut TxContext|,
168 | ) {
169 |     let runner = $runner;
170 |     let scenario = runner.scenario();
171 |     scenario.next_tx($sender);
172 |     let mut staking = scenario.take_shared<Staking>();
173 |     let mut system = scenario.take_shared<System>();
174 |     let mut upgrade_manager = scenario.take_shared<UpgradeManager>();
175 |     let ctx = scenario.ctx();
176 | 
177 |     $f(&mut staking, &mut system, &mut upgrade_manager, ctx);
178 | 
179 |     test_scenario::return_shared(upgrade_manager);
180 |     test_scenario::return_shared(staking);
181 |     test_scenario::return_shared(system);
182 | }
183 | 
184 | /// Destroy the test runner and all resources.
185 | public fun destroy(self: TestRunner) {
186 |     test_utils::destroy(self)
187 | }
188 | 
189 | #[allow(lint(self_transfer), unused_mut_ref)]
190 | public fun setup_committee_for_epoch_one(): (TestRunner, vector<TestStorageNode>) {
191 |     let admin = @0xA11CE;
192 |     let mut nodes = test_node::test_nodes();
193 |     let mut runner = prepare(admin).build();
194 |     let commission_rate: u16 = 0;
195 |     let storage_price: u64 = 5;
196 |     let write_price: u64 = 1;
197 |     let node_capacity: u64 = 1_000_000_000;
198 | 
199 |     // === register candidates ===
200 |     let epoch = runner.epoch();
201 |     nodes.do_mut!(|node| {
202 |         runner.tx!(node.sui_address(), |staking, _, ctx| {
203 |             let cap = staking.register_candidate(
204 |                 node.name(),
205 |                 node.network_address(),
206 |                 node_metadata::default(),
207 |                 node.bls_pk(),
208 |                 node.network_key(),
209 |                 node.create_proof_of_possession(epoch),
210 |                 commission_rate,
211 |                 storage_price,
212 |                 write_price,
213 |                 node_capacity,
214 |                 ctx,
215 |             );
216 |             node.set_storage_node_cap(cap);
217 |         });
218 |     });
219 | 
220 |     // === stake with each node ===
221 | 
222 |     nodes.do_ref!(|node| {
223 |         runner.tx!(node.sui_address(), |staking, _, ctx| {
224 |             let coin = walrus_test_utils::mint_wal(1000, ctx);
225 |             let staked_wal = staking.stake_with_pool(coin, node.node_id(), ctx);
226 |             transfer::public_transfer(staked_wal, ctx.sender());
227 |         });
228 |     });
229 | 
230 |     // === advance clock and end voting ===
231 |     // === check if epoch state is changed correctly ==
232 | 
233 |     runner.clock().increment_for_testing(DEFAULT_EPOCH_ZERO_DURATION);
234 |     runner.tx!(admin, |staking, system, _| {
235 |         staking.voting_end(runner.clock());
236 |         staking.initiate_epoch_change(system, runner.clock());
237 |         nodes.do_ref!(|node| assert!(system.committee().contains(&node.node_id())));
238 |     });
239 | 
240 |     // === send epoch sync done messages from all nodes ===
241 |     let epoch = runner.epoch();
242 |     nodes.do_mut!(|node| {
243 |         runner.tx!(node.sui_address(), |staking, _, _| {
244 |             staking.epoch_sync_done(node.cap_mut(), epoch, runner.clock());
245 |         });
246 |     });
247 | 
248 |     (runner, nodes)
249 | }

4 | #[allow(unused_mut_ref)]
5 | module walrus::e2e_tests;

7 | use std::unit_test::assert_eq;
8 | use walrus::{auth, e2e_runner, staking_pool, test_node::{Self, TestStorageNode}, test_utils};
9 | 
10 | const COMMISSION_RATE: u16 = 0;
11 | const STORAGE_PRICE: u64 = 5;
12 | const WRITE_PRICE: u64 = 1;
13 | const NODE_CAPACITY: u64 = 1_000_000_000;
14 | const N_SHARDS: u16 = 100;
15 | 
16 | /// Taken from `walrus::staking`. Must be the same values as there.
17 | const EPOCH_DURATION: u64 = 7 * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000;
18 | const PARAM_SELECTION_DELTA: u64 = 7 * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000 / 2;
19 | const EPOCH_ZERO_DURATION: u64 = 100000000;
20 | 
21 | #[test]
22 | fun test_init_and_first_epoch_change() {
23 |     let admin = @0xA11CE;
24 |     let mut nodes = test_node::test_nodes();
25 |     let mut runner = e2e_runner::prepare(admin)
26 |         .epoch_zero_duration(EPOCH_ZERO_DURATION)
27 |         .epoch_duration(EPOCH_DURATION)
28 |         .n_shards(N_SHARDS)
29 |         .build();
30 | 
31 |     // === register candidates ===
32 |     let epoch = runner.epoch();
33 |     nodes.do_mut!(|node| {
34 |         runner.tx!(node.sui_address(), |staking, _, ctx| {
35 |             let cap = staking.register_candidate(
36 |                 node.name(),
37 |                 node.network_address(),
38 |                 node.metadata(),
39 |                 node.bls_pk(),
40 |                 node.network_key(),
41 |                 node.create_proof_of_possession(epoch),
42 |                 COMMISSION_RATE,
43 |                 STORAGE_PRICE,
44 |                 WRITE_PRICE,
45 |                 NODE_CAPACITY,
46 |                 ctx,
47 |             );
48 |             node.set_storage_node_cap(cap);
49 |         });
50 |     });
51 | 
52 |     // === stake with each node ===
53 | 
54 |     nodes.do_ref!(|node| {
55 |         runner.tx!(node.sui_address(), |staking, _, ctx| {
56 |             let coin = test_utils::mint_wal(1000, ctx);
57 |             let staked_wal = staking.stake_with_pool(coin, node.node_id(), ctx);
58 |             transfer::public_transfer(staked_wal, ctx.sender());
59 |         });
60 |     });
61 | 
62 |     // === advance clock and end voting ===
63 |     // === check if epoch state is changed correctly ==
64 | 
65 |     runner.clock().increment_for_testing(EPOCH_ZERO_DURATION);
66 |     runner.tx!(admin, |staking, system, _| {
67 |         staking.voting_end(runner.clock());
68 |         staking.initiate_epoch_change(system, runner.clock());
69 | 
70 |         assert!(system.epoch() == 1);
71 |         assert!(system.committee().n_shards() == N_SHARDS);
72 | 
73 |         nodes.do_ref!(|node| assert!(system.committee().contains(&node.node_id())));
74 |     });
75 | 
76 |     // === send epoch sync done messages from all nodes ===
77 |     let epoch = runner.epoch();
78 |     nodes.do_mut!(|node| {
79 |         runner.tx!(node.sui_address(), |staking, _, _| {
80 |             staking.epoch_sync_done(node.cap_mut(), epoch, runner.clock());
81 |         });
82 |     });
83 | 
84 |     // === perform another epoch change ===
85 |     // === check if epoch state is changed correctly ==
86 | 
87 |     runner.clock().increment_for_testing(PARAM_SELECTION_DELTA);
88 |     runner.tx!(admin, |staking, _, _| {
89 |         assert!(staking.is_epoch_sync_done());
90 |         staking.voting_end(runner.clock());
91 |     });
92 | 
93 |     // === advance clock and change epoch ===
94 |     // === check if epoch was changed as expected ===
95 | 
96 |     runner.clock().increment_for_testing(EPOCH_DURATION - PARAM_SELECTION_DELTA);
97 |     runner.tx!(admin, |staking, system, _| {
98 |         staking.initiate_epoch_change(system, runner.clock());
99 | 
100 |         assert!(system.epoch() == 2);
101 |         assert!(system.committee().n_shards() == N_SHARDS);
102 | 
103 |         nodes.do_ref!(|node| assert!(system.committee().contains(&node.node_id())));
104 |     });
105 | 
106 |     // === send epoch sync done messages from all nodes ===
107 |     let epoch = runner.epoch();
108 |     nodes.do_mut!(|node| {
109 |         runner.tx!(node.sui_address(), |staking, _, _| {
110 |             staking.epoch_sync_done(node.cap_mut(), epoch, runner.clock());
111 |         });
112 |     });
113 | 
114 |     // === check if epoch state is changed correctly ==
115 | 
116 |     runner.tx!(admin, |staking, _, _| assert!(staking.is_epoch_sync_done()));
117 | 
118 |     // === cleanup ===
119 | 
120 |     nodes.destroy!(|node| node.destroy());
121 |     runner.destroy();
122 | }

124 | #[test]
125 | fun test_stake_after_committee_selection() {
126 |     let admin = @0xA11CE;
127 |     let mut nodes = test_node::test_nodes();
128 |     let mut runner = e2e_runner::prepare(admin)
129 |         .epoch_zero_duration(EPOCH_ZERO_DURATION)
130 |         .epoch_duration(EPOCH_DURATION)
131 |         .n_shards(N_SHARDS)
132 |         .build();
133 | 
134 |     // === register candidates ===
135 |     let epoch = runner.epoch();
136 |     nodes.do_mut!(|node| {
137 |         runner.tx!(node.sui_address(), |staking, _, ctx| {
138 |             let cap = staking.register_candidate(
139 |                 node.name(),
140 |                 node.network_address(),
141 |                 node.metadata(),
142 |                 node.bls_pk(),
143 |                 node.network_key(),
144 |                 node.create_proof_of_possession(epoch),
145 |                 COMMISSION_RATE,
146 |                 STORAGE_PRICE,
147 |                 WRITE_PRICE,
148 |                 NODE_CAPACITY,
149 |                 ctx,
150 |             );
151 |             node.set_storage_node_cap(cap);
152 |         });
153 |     });
154 | 
155 |     // === stake with each node except one ===
156 | 
157 |     let excluded_node = nodes.pop_back();
158 | 
159 |     nodes.do_ref!(|node| {
160 |         runner.tx!(node.sui_address(), |staking, _, ctx| {
161 |             let coin = test_utils::mint_wal(1000, ctx);
162 |             let staked_wal = staking.stake_with_pool(coin, node.node_id(), ctx);
163 |             transfer::public_transfer(staked_wal, ctx.sender());
164 |         });
165 |     });
166 | 
167 |     // === advance clock and end voting ===
168 | 
169 |     runner.clock().increment_for_testing(EPOCH_ZERO_DURATION);
170 |     runner.tx!(admin, |staking, _, _| {
171 |         staking.voting_end(runner.clock());
172 |     });
173 | 
174 |     // === add stake to excluded node ===
175 | 
176 |     runner.tx!(excluded_node.sui_address(), |staking, _, ctx| {
177 |         let coin = test_utils::mint_wal(1000, ctx);
178 |         let staked_wal = staking.stake_with_pool(coin, excluded_node.node_id(), ctx);
179 |         transfer::public_transfer(staked_wal, ctx.sender());
180 |     });
181 | 
182 |     // === initiate epoch change ===
183 |     // === check if epoch state is changed correctly ==
184 | 
185 |     runner.tx!(admin, |staking, system, _| {
186 |         staking.initiate_epoch_change(system, runner.clock());
187 | 
188 |         assert!(system.epoch() == 1);
189 |         assert!(system.committee().n_shards() == N_SHARDS);
190 | 
191 |         // all nodes initially staked with are in the committee
192 |         nodes.do_ref!(|node| assert!(system.committee().contains(&node.node_id())));
193 |         // excluded node is not in the committee
194 |         assert!(!system.committee().contains(&excluded_node.node_id()));
195 |     });
196 | 
197 |     // === send epoch sync done messages from all nodes in the committee ===
198 |     let epoch = runner.epoch();
199 |     nodes.do_mut!(|node| {
200 |         runner.tx!(node.sui_address(), |staking, _, _| {
201 |             staking.epoch_sync_done(node.cap_mut(), epoch, runner.clock());
202 |         });
203 |     });
204 | 
205 |     // === advance clock and change epoch ===
206 |     // === check if previously excluded node is now also in the committee ===
207 | 
208 |     runner.clock().increment_for_testing(EPOCH_DURATION);
209 |     runner.tx!(admin, |staking, system, _| {
210 |         staking.voting_end(runner.clock());
211 |         staking.initiate_epoch_change(system, runner.clock());
212 | 
213 |         assert!(system.epoch() == 2);
214 |         assert!(system.committee().n_shards() == N_SHARDS);
215 | 
216 |         // all nodes initially staked with are in the committee
217 |         nodes.do_ref!(|node| assert!(system.committee().contains(&node.node_id())));
218 |         // previously excluded node is now also in the committee
219 |         assert!(system.committee().contains(&excluded_node.node_id()));
220 |     });
221 | 
222 |     // === cleanup ===
223 |

14 | public fun test_emergency_upgrade() {

17 |     let admin = @0xA11CE;
18 |     let mut runner = e2e_runner::prepare(admin).build();

20 |     let emergency_cap: EmergencyUpgradeCap = runner.scenario().take_from_address(admin);
21 |     runner.tx_with_upgrade_manager!(admin, |staking, system, upgrade_manager, _| {
22 |         // Check that the new package id is not set before the upgrade
23 |         assert!(system.new_package_id().is_none() && staking.new_package_id().is_none());
24 | 
25 |         let upgrade_ticket = upgrade_manager.authorize_emergency_upgrade(
26 |             &emergency_cap,
27 |             vector<u8>[],
28 |         );
29 |         let receipt = package::test_upgrade(upgrade_ticket);
30 |         upgrade_manager.commit_upgrade(staking, system, receipt);
31 | 
32 |         // Check that the new package id is set after the upgrade and is the same for both the
33 |         // system and staking objects.
34 |         assert!(system.new_package_id().is_some());
35 |         assert_eq!(system.new_package_id(), staking.new_package_id());
36 |     });
37 |     test_scenario::return_to_address(admin, emergency_cap);
38 |     runner.destroy();

42 | public fun test_quorum_upgrade() {
43 |     let (mut runner, nodes) = e2e_runner::setup_committee_for_epoch_one();
44 | 
45 |     // === vote for upgrade ===
46 |     // minimum number of votes needed since stake is equally distributed
47 |     let n_votes = nodes.length() * 2 / 3 + 1;
48 |     let digest = upgrade::digest_for_testing(runner.scenario().ctx());
49 |     n_votes.do!(|idx| {
50 |         let node = &nodes[idx];
51 |         runner.tx_with_upgrade_manager!(node.sui_address(), |staking, _, upgrade_manager, ctx| {
52 |             let auth = auth::authenticate_sender(ctx);
53 |             upgrade_manager.vote_for_upgrade(staking, auth, node.node_id(), digest)
54 |         });
55 |     });
56 | 
57 |     // === commit upgrade ===
58 | 
59 |     runner.tx_with_upgrade_manager!(nodes[0].sui_address(), |staking, system, upgrade_manager, _| {
60 |         // Check that the new package id is not set before the upgrade
61 |         assert!(system.new_package_id().is_none() && staking.new_package_id().is_none());
62 | 
63 |         let upgrade_ticket = upgrade_manager.authorize_upgrade(staking, digest);
64 |         let receipt = package::test_upgrade(upgrade_ticket);
65 |         upgrade_manager.commit_upgrade(staking, system, receipt);
66 | 
67 |         // Check that the new package id is set after the upgrade and is the same for both the
68 |         // system and staking objects.
69 |         assert!(system.new_package_id().is_some());
70 |         assert_eq!(system.new_package_id(), staking.new_package_id());
71 |     });
72 |

74 | 
75 |     runner.destroy();
76 |     nodes.destroy!(|node| node.destroy());
77 | }

79 | #[test, expected_failure(abort_code = upgrade::ENotEnoughVotes)]
80 | public fun test_upgrade_insufficient_votes() {
81 |     let (mut runner, nodes) = e2e_runner::setup_committee_for_epoch_one();
82 | 
83 |     // === vote for upgrade ===
84 |     // just shy of a quorum since stake is equally distributed
85 |     let n_votes = nodes.length() * 2 / 3;
86 | 
87 |     let digest = upgrade::digest_for_testing(runner.scenario().ctx());
88 |     n_votes.do!(|idx| {
89 |         let node = &nodes[idx];
90 |         runner.tx_with_upgrade_manager!(node.sui_address(), |staking, _, upgrade_manager, ctx| {
91 |             let auth = auth::authenticate_sender(ctx);
92 |             upgrade_manager.vote_for_upgrade(staking, auth, node.node_id(), digest)
93 |         });
94 |     });
95 | 
96 |     // === try to commit upgrade ===
97 | 
98 |     runner.tx_with_upgrade_manager!(nodes[0].sui_address(), |staking, _, upgrade_manager, _| {
99 |         // Test should fail here.
100 |         let _upgrade_ticket = upgrade_manager.authorize_upgrade(staking, digest);
101 |     });
102 | 
103 |     // Unreachable
104 |     abort

107 | #[test, expected_failure(abort_code = upgrade::EWrongEpoch)]
108 | public fun test_upgrade_wrong_epoch() {
109 |     let (mut runner, nodes) = e2e_runner::setup_committee_for_epoch_one();
110 | 
111 |     // === vote for upgrade ===
112 | 
113 |     let digest = upgrade::digest_for_testing(runner.scenario().ctx());
114 |     nodes.do_ref!(|node| {
115 |         runner.tx_with_upgrade_manager!(node.sui_address(), |staking, _, upgrade_manager, ctx| {
116 |             let auth = auth::authenticate_sender(ctx);
117 |             upgrade_manager.vote_for_upgrade(staking, auth, node.node_id(), digest)
118 |         });
119 |     });
120 | 
121 |     // === advance clock and change epoch ===
122 | 
123 |     runner.clock().increment_for_testing(e2e_runner::default_epoch_duration());
124 |     runner.tx!(nodes[0].sui_address(), |staking, system, _| {
125 |         staking.voting_end(runner.clock());
126 |         staking.initiate_epoch_change(system, runner.clock());
127 |         assert_eq!(system.epoch(), 2);
128 |     });
129 | 
130 |     // === try to commit upgrade with the package voted for in the previous epoch ===
131 | 
132 |     runner.tx_with_upgrade_manager!(nodes[0].sui_address(), |staking, _, upgrade_manager, _| {
133 |         // Test should fail here.
134 |         let _upgrade_ticket = upgrade_manager.authorize_upgrade(staking, digest);
135 |     });
136 | 
137 |     // Unreachable
138 |     abort
139 | }
140 | 
141 | #[test, expected_failure(abort_code = upgrade::EWrongVersion)]
142 | public fun test_upgrade_wrong_version() {
143 |     let (mut runner, nodes) = e2e_runner::setup_committee_for_epoch_one();
144 | 
145 |     // === vote for upgrade 1 ===
146 | 
147 |     let digest_1 = upgrade::digest_for_testing(runner.scenario().ctx());
148 |     nodes.do_ref!(|node| {
149 |         runner.tx_with_upgrade_manager!(node.sui_address(), |staking, _, upgrade_manager, ctx| {
150 |             let auth = auth::authenticate_sender(ctx);
151 |             upgrade_manager.vote_for_upgrade(staking, auth, node.node_id(), digest_1)
152 |         });
153 |     });
154 | 
155 |     // === vote for upgrade 2 ===
156 | 
157 |     let digest_2 = upgrade::digest_for_testing(runner.scenario().ctx());
158 |     nodes.do_ref!(|node| {
159 |         runner.tx_with_upgrade_manager!(node.sui_address(), |staking, _, upgrade_manager, ctx| {
160 |             let auth = auth::authenticate_sender(ctx);
161 |             upgrade_manager.vote_for_upgrade(staking, auth, node.node_id(), digest_2)

163 |     });
164 |     // === upgrade to digest 1 ===

167 |         let upgrade_ticket = upgrade_manager.authorize_upgrade(staking, digest_1);
168 |         let receipt = package::test_upgrade(upgrade_ticket);
169 |         upgrade_manager.commit_upgrade(staking, system, receipt);
170 |     });
171 |

175 |         // Test should fail here.
176 |         let _upgrade_ticket = upgrade_manager.authorize_upgrade(staking, digest_2);
177 |     });
178 | 
179 |     // Unreachable
180 |     abort
181 | }

move-book/site/src/plugins/mdbook-anchor-code.ts
```
1 | // Copyright (c) Mysten Labs, Inc.
2 | // SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
3 | 
4 | import fs from 'fs';
5 | import path from 'path';
6 | import { visit } from 'unist-util-visit';
7 | import type { Plugin } from 'unified';
8 | import type { Root } from 'mdast';
9 | 
10 | interface Options {
11 |   rootDir?: string;
12 | }
13 | 
14 | const plugin: Plugin<[Options?], Root> = ({ rootDir = process.cwd() } = {}) => {
15 |   return (tree, file) => {
16 |     visit(tree, 'code', (node) => {
17 |       if (!node.meta) return;
18 | 
19 |       const match = node.meta.match(/file=(\S+)/);
20 |       if (!match) return;
21 | 
22 |       const anchorMatch = node.meta.match(/anchor=(\S+)/);
23 |       if (!anchorMatch) return;
24 | 
25 |       let [filePathWithAnchor] = match.slice(1);
26 |       let [anchor] = anchorMatch.slice(1);
27 | 
28 |       const absPath = path.resolve(rootDir, filePathWithAnchor);
29 |       if (!fs.existsSync(absPath)) {
30 |         throw new Error(`File not found: ${absPath}`);
31 |       }
32 | 
33 |       let content = fs.readFileSync(absPath, 'utf-8');
34 | 
35 |       if (anchor) {
36 |         const startMarker = new RegExp(`//\\s*ANCHOR:\\s*${anchor}`);
37 |         const endMarker = new RegExp(`//\\s*ANCHOR_END:\\s*${anchor}`);
38 | 
39 |         const lines = content.split('\n');
40 |         const start = lines.findIndex((line) => startMarker.test(line));
41 |         if (start === -1) {
42 |           throw new Error(`Anchor "${anchor}" not found in ${absPath}`);
43 |         }
44 | 
45 |         const end = lines.findIndex((line, i) => i > start && endMarker.test(line));
46 |         if (end === -1) {
47 |           throw new Error(`No end anchor for "${anchor}" in ${absPath}`);
48 |         }
49 | 
50 |         content = lines
51 |           .slice(start + 1, end)
52 |           .filter((e) => !e.includes('// ANCHOR_END') && !e.includes('// ANCHOR'))
53 |           .join('\n');
54 |       }
55 | 
56 |       node.value = node.value + content;
57 |     });
58 |   };
59 | };
60 | 
61 | export default plugin;
```

5 | import fs from 'fs';
6 | import type { SidebarsConfig } from '@docusaurus/plugin-content-docs';
7 | import type { SidebarItemConfig } from '@docusaurus/plugin-content-docs/lib/sidebars/types.js';
8 | 
9 | type ExtendedSidebarItemConfig = SidebarItemConfig & {
10 |   enumerate?: boolean;
11 | };
12 | 
13 | /**
14 |  * Loads a sidebar from a YAML file and returns a SidebarsConfig object.
15 |  * Docusaurus will error out if the sidebar is not valid.
16 |  *
17 |  * @param yamlPath - The path to the YAML file.
18 |  * @returns A SidebarsConfig object.
19 |  */
20 | export function loadSidebarsFromYaml(yamlPath: string): SidebarsConfig {
21 |   const sidebars: SidebarsConfig = {};
22 | 
23 |   // Read all YAML files in the directory
24 |   const yamlContent = fs.readFileSync(yamlPath, 'utf8');
25 |   const sidebarConfig = yaml.parse(yamlContent);
26 | 
27 |   // Enumerate or keep config as is.
28 |   Object.entries(sidebarConfig).forEach(([key, value]) => {
29 |     sidebars[key] = processSidebar(value as ExtendedSidebarItemConfig[]);
30 |   });
31 | 
32 |   return sidebars;
33 | }
34 | 
35 | /**
36 |  * Enumerate the sidebar items.
37 |  * Supports custom `enumerate` tag.
38 |  *
39 |  * @param sidebar - The sidebar to enumerate.
40 |  * @param parentIndex - The index of the parent item (for recursive enumeration).
41 |  * @returns The enumerated sidebar.
42 |  */
43 | export function processSidebar(
44 |   sidebar: ExtendedSidebarItemConfig[],
45 |   parentIndex?: number,
46 |   parentEnumerate: boolean = true,
47 | ): SidebarItemConfig[] {
48 |   let index = 0;
49 | 
50 |   return sidebar.map((item) => {
51 |     // plain autogenerated items
52 |     if (typeof item === 'string') {
53 |       return item;
54 |     }
55 | 
56 |     let enumerate = (item.enumerate == false ? false : true) && parentEnumerate;
57 |     'enumerate' in item && delete item.enumerate; // strip illegal tags
58 | 
59 |     // default to doc if type not specified
60 |     if (item.type === undefined) {
61 |       item.type = 'doc';
62 |     }
63 | 
64 |     // enumerate category header if it has a label and link
65 |     if (enumerate && item.type === 'category' && item.label && item.link) {
66 |       index++;
67 |       item.label = `${parentIndex ? `${parentIndex}.` : ''}${index}. ${item.label}`;
68 |     }
69 | 
70 |     // enumerate category items
71 |     // if category has no enumeration, items are not children but top level items
72 |     if (item.type === 'category' && item.items) {
73 |       item.items = processSidebar(item.items as ExtendedSidebarItemConfig[], index, enumerate);
74 |     }
75 | 
76 |     if (enumerate && item.type === 'doc' && item.label) {
77 |       index++;
78 |       item.label = `${parentIndex ? `${parentIndex}.` : ''}${index}. ${item.label}`;
79 |     }
80 | 
81 |     return item;
82 |   });
83 | }
```

move-book/site/src/theme/prism-include-languages.js
```
1 | // Copyright (c) Mysten Labs, Inc.
2 | // SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
3 | 
4 | import siteConfig from '@generated/docusaurus.config';
5 | export default function prismIncludeLanguages(PrismObject) {
6 |   const {
7 |     themeConfig: { prism },
8 |   } = siteConfig;
9 |   const { additionalLanguages } = prism;
10 |   // Prism components work on the Prism instance on the window, while prism-
11 |   // react-renderer uses its own Prism instance. We temporarily mount the
12 |   // instance onto window, import components to enhance it, then remove it to
13 |   // avoid polluting global namespace.
14 |   // You can mutate PrismObject: registering plugins, deleting languages... As
15 |   // long as you don't re-assign it
16 |   globalThis.Prism = PrismObject;
17 |   additionalLanguages.forEach((lang) => {
18 |     // eslint-disable-next-line global-require, import/no-dynamic-require
19 |     require(`prismjs/components/prism-${lang}`);
20 |   });
21 |   require('./prism-move');
22 |   delete globalThis.Prism;
23 | }

1 | // Copyright (c) Mysten Labs, Inc.
2 | // SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
3 | 
4 | /// Contains an active set of storage nodes. The active set is a smart collection
5 | /// that only stores up to a 1000 nodes. The active set tracks the total amount of staked
6 | /// WAL to make the calculation of the rewards and voting power distribution easier.
7 | ///
8 | /// TODOs:
9 | /// - consider using a different data structure for the active set (#714)
10 | /// - consider removing `min_stake` field, use threshold from number of
11 | ///   shards and total_staked (#715)
12 | module walrus::active_set;
13 | 
14 | // Error codes
15 | // Error types in `walrus-sui/types/move_errors.rs` are auto-generated from the Move error codes.
16 | /// The maximum size of an ActiveSet must be strictly larger than zero.
17 | const EZeroMaxSize: u64 = 0;
18 | /// The node is already part of the active set.
19 | const EDuplicateInsertion: u64 = 1;
20 | 
21 | public struct ActiveSetEntry has copy, drop, store {
22 |     node_id: ID,
23 |     staked_amount: u64,
24 | }
25 | 
26 | /// The active set of storage nodes, a smart collection that only stores up
27 | /// to a 1000 nodes.
28 | /// Additionally, the active set tracks the total amount of staked WAL to make
29 | /// the calculation of the rewards and voting power distribution easier.
30 | ///
31 | /// TODO: implement a reserve to track N + K nodes, where N is the active set
32 | /// size and K is the number of nodes that are in the process of being added to
33 | /// the active set. This will allow us to handle removals from the active set
34 | /// without refetching the nodes from the storage.
35 | public struct ActiveSet has copy, drop, store {
36 |     /// The maximum number of storage nodes in the active set.
37 |     /// Potentially remove this field.
38 |     max_size: u16,
39 |     /// The minimum amount of staked WAL needed to enter the active set. This is used to
40 |     /// determine if a storage node can be added to the active set.
41 |     threshold_stake: u64,
42 |     /// The list of storage nodes in the active set and their stake.
43 |     nodes: vector<ActiveSetEntry>,
44 |     /// The total amount of staked WAL in the active set.
45 |     total_stake: u64,
46 | }
47 | 
48 | /// Creates a new active set with the given `size` and `threshold_stake`. The
49 | /// latter is used to filter out storage nodes that do not have enough staked
50 | /// WAL to be included in the active set initially.
51 | public(package) fun new(max_size: u16, threshold_stake: u64): ActiveSet {
52 |     assert!(max_size > 0, EZeroMaxSize);
53 |     ActiveSet {
54 |         max_size,
55 |         threshold_stake,
56 |         nodes: vector[],
57 |         total_stake: 0,
58 |     }
59 | }
60 | 
61 | /// Inserts the node if it is not already in the active set, otherwise updates its stake.
62 | /// If the node's stake is below the threshold value, it is removed from the set.
63 | /// Returns true if the node is in the set after the operation, false otherwise.
64 | public(package) fun insert_or_update(set: &mut ActiveSet, node_id: ID, staked_amount: u64): bool {
65 |     // Currently, the `threshold_stake` is set to `0`, so we need to account for that.
66 |     if (staked_amount == 0 || staked_amount < set.threshold_stake) {
67 |         set.remove(node_id);
68 |         return false
69 |     };
70 | 
71 |     if (set.update(node_id, staked_amount)) true
72 |     else set.insert(node_id, staked_amount)
73 | }
74 | 
75 | /// Updates the staked amount of the storage node with the given `node_id` in
76 | /// the active set. Returns true if the node is in the set.
77 | public(package) fun update(set: &mut ActiveSet, node_id: ID, staked_amount: u64): bool {
78 |     let index = set.nodes.find_index!(|entry| entry.node_id == node_id);
79 |     if (index.is_none()) {
80 |         return false
81 |     };
82 |     index.do!(|idx| {
83 |         set.total_stake = set.total_stake + staked_amount - set.nodes[idx].staked_amount;
84 |         set.nodes[idx].staked_amount = staked_amount;
85 |     });
86 |     true
87 | }
88 | 
89 | /// Inserts a storage node with the given `node_id` and `staked_amount` into the
90 | /// active set. The node is only added if it has enough staked WAL to be included
91 | /// in the active set. If the active set is full, the node with the smallest
92 | /// staked WAL is removed to make space for the new node.
93 | /// Returns true if the node was inserted, false otherwise.
94 | fun insert(set: &mut ActiveSet, node_id: ID, staked_amount: u64): bool {
95 |     assert!(set.nodes.find_index!(|entry| entry.node_id == node_id).is_none(), EDuplicateInsertion);
96 | 
97 |     // If the nodes are less than the max size, insert the node.
98 |     if (set.nodes.length() as u16 < set.max_size) {
99 |         set.total_stake = set.total_stake + staked_amount;
100 |         set.nodes.push_back(ActiveSetEntry { node_id, staked_amount });
101 |         return true
102 |     };
103 | 
104 |     // Find the node with the smallest amount of stake and less than the new node.
105 |     let mut min_stake = staked_amount;
106 |     let mut min_idx = option::none();
107 |     set.nodes.length().do!(|i| {
108 |         if (set.nodes[i].staked_amount < min_stake) {
109 |             min_idx = option::some(i);
110 |             min_stake = set.nodes[i].staked_amount;
111 |         }
112 |     });
113 | 
114 |     // If there is such a node, replace it in the list.
115 |     if (min_idx.is_some()) {
116 |         let min_idx = min_idx.extract();
117 |         set.total_stake = set.total_stake - min_stake + staked_amount;
118 |         *&mut set.nodes[min_idx] = ActiveSetEntry { node_id, staked_amount };
119 |         true
120 |     } else {
121 |         false
122 |     }
123 | }
124 | 
125 | /// Removes the storage node with the given `node_id` from the active set.
126 | public(package) fun remove(set: &mut ActiveSet, node_id: ID) {
127 |     let index = set.nodes.find_index!(|entry| entry.node_id == node_id);
128 |     index.do!(|idx| {
129 |         let entry = set.nodes.swap_remove(idx);
130 |         set.total_stake = set.total_stake - entry.staked_amount;
131 |     });
132 | }
133 | 
134 | /// Sets the maximum size of the active set.
135 | #[test_only]
136 | public(package) fun set_max_size(set: &mut ActiveSet, max_size: u16) {
137 |     set.max_size = max_size;
138 | }
139 | 
140 | /// The maximum size of the active set.
141 | public(package) fun max_size(set: &ActiveSet): u16 { set.max_size }
142 | 
143 | /// The current size of the active set.
144 | public(package) fun size(set: &ActiveSet): u16 { set.nodes.length() as u16 }
145 | 
146 | /// The IDs of the nodes in the active set.
147 | public(package) fun active_ids(set: &ActiveSet): vector<ID> {
148 |     set.nodes.map_ref!(|node| node.node_id)
149 | }
150 | 
151 | /// The IDs and stake of the nodes in the active set.
152 | public(package) fun active_ids_and_stake(set: &ActiveSet): (vector<ID>, vector<u64>) {
153 |     let mut active_ids = vector[];
154 |     let mut stake = vector[];
155 |     set.nodes.do_ref!(|entry| {
156 |         active_ids.push_back(entry.node_id);
157 |         stake.push_back(entry.staked_amount);
158 |     });
159 |     (active_ids, stake)
160 | }
161 | 
162 | /// The minimum amount of staked WAL in the active set.
163 | public(package) fun threshold_stake(set: &ActiveSet): u64 { set.threshold_stake }
164 | 
165 | /// The total amount of staked WAL in the active set.
166 | public(package) fun total_stake(set: &ActiveSet): u64 { set.total_stake }
167 | 
168 | /// Current minimum stake needed to be in the active set.
169 | /// If the active set is full, the minimum stake is the stake of the node with the smallest stake.
170 | /// Otherwise, the minimum stake is the threshold stake.
171 | /// Test only to discourage using this since it iterates over all nodes. When the `min_stake` is
172 | /// needed within [`ActiveSet`], prefer inlining/integrating it in other loops.
173 | #[test_only]
174 | public(package) fun cur_min_stake(set: &ActiveSet): u64 {
175 |     if (set.nodes.length() == set.max_size as u64) {
176 |         let mut min_stake = std::u64::max_value!();
177 |         set.nodes.length().do!(|i| {
178 |             if (set.nodes[i].staked_amount < min_stake) {
179 |                 min_stake = set.nodes[i].staked_amount;
180 |             }
181 |         });
182 |         min_stake
183 |     } else {
184 |         set.threshold_stake
185 |     }
186 | }
187 | 
188 | #[test_only]
189 | public fun stake_for_node(set: &ActiveSet, node_id: ID): u64 {
190 |     set
191 |         .nodes
192 |         .find_index!(|entry| entry.node_id == node_id)
193 |         .map!(|index| set.nodes[index].staked_amount)
194 |         .destroy_or!(0)
195 | }
